verdict.rationale: GitHub Codespaces offers a 'full, cloud-based development environment' (github-docs-3) that could serve as an isolated sandbox for coding/testing, but there is no explicit documentation tying this to safely testing against non-production data or separating staging from production. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment separate from production data, evidence of data isolation guarantees, and confirmation that AI agents (Copilot cloud agent) operate in an isolated sandbox rather than live repos/production systems.
